question: arXiv 论文（paper_id=2502.19154v2）导出的 eprint 字段值是什么（版本号是否被剥掉）？
verify:
import re
import kb_search
out = kb_search.format_bibtex({'paper_id': '2502.19154v2', 'title': 'T', 'authors': '["A B"]', 'year': '2025', 'categories': 'cs.CL'})
result = re.search(r'eprint\s*=\s*\{([^}]*)\}', out).group(1)

question: tests/test_kb_search_unit.py 里以 test_ 开头的方法共多少个（ast 现数）？
verify:
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import kb_health
root = Path(kb_health.__file__).resolve().parent
tree = ast.parse((root / 'tests' / 'test_kb_search_unit.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
result = sum(1 for cls in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(cls, ast.ClassDef) for fn in cls.body if isinstance(fn, ast.FunctionDef) and fn.name.startswith('test_'))
